title: Deep active learning identifies lithium-metal battery electrolytes with longer symmetric-cell lifetime
summary: A two-stage framework combines deep-kernel active learning with transfer to expanded formulation spaces. The primary article reports electrolytes that increased average lifetime of lithium-metal symmetric cells threefold after three learning iterations and improved formulations in lithium-metal full cells. These are study-specific battery tests, not commercial-pack or independent replication evidence.
ai_technology: Deep-kernel active learning; target statistic coding; knowledge transfer

evidence.tested: The primary source reports the study-specific result summarized here.
evidence.unknown: Independent replication and commercial deployment are not established.
evidence.ai_role: Deep active learning selects informative experiments and models formulation performance; statistic coding transfers learned information to expanded composition spaces.

source_review.scope: Primary publisher article, abstract and introductory methods/context
